title: Match frontend field bindings strictly to canonical API snake_case schemas
context_summary: The /neurohands lessons panel rendered empty Fix and Check lines during U12 pilot testing.
observation: Frontend JS read camelCase keys while DEV_LESSONS_LEDGER.json exposed snake_case keys (error_signature, approved_fix, regression_test).
verified_action: Bind DOM textContent directly to canonical snake_case response fields and assert non-empty rendered cards in headless CDP pilot checks.
